basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Pinbord collects no data. There are no servers, no accounts and no third-party trackers. Your notes stay on your device, or in your own private iCloud if you turn sync on.
onDevice: Your notes, boards, checklists, photos and stickers
Deleted notes, kept for 30 days so you can restore them

permissions.name: Photos
permissions.why: Only when you add a photo to a note.

purchases: Studio Pass is sold through the App Store as a one-time purchase or a subscription. Apple handles payment.
